name: Mars Orbiter
goal: Find where water once shaped Mars, and scout safe sites for future landers.
objectives: Image candidate landing sites at high resolution
Identify water-related minerals on the surface

_notes.units: Unit scales follow GDD 8.5, derived from real MRO figures (JPL MRO press kit).
_notes.dvMOI: About 1,000 m/s orbit insertion (JPL MRO press kit).
_notes.dvOther: Game assumption for cruise corrections and orbit operations. Approximate.
_notes.isp: Approximate value for hydrazine. Needs a NASA source (GDD 15.1).
_notes.costs: Ops 180 and bus share follow the real split: 450 spacecraft and instruments, 90 launch, 180 operations (JPL MRO press kit).
